commit.message: docs(planner): adopt PCP-first repository planner design

pr.title: docs(planner): design PCP-first repository merge planner
pr.body: Corrects the planner architecture to reuse merged PCP Core and existing dNh RDCP evidence machinery. Adds five inactive, dependency-ordered implementation packets. Design-only draft: no runtime changes, authority mutation, model call before head freeze, or merge authority.

steps.task: Reconcile the existing design against current Dopemux PCP, dNh RDCP, and AdOps authority evidence.
requirements: Treat current source and accepted schemas as higher authority than the earlier design.
Remove the proposed repository-planner-export.v1 parallel contract.
Remove the proposed dNh tools/gov port into AdOps.
Mark unsupported conversation-history API access as unavailable rather than inferred.
validation: The RFC names PCP Core as the generic substrate and RDCP as an extension source.
The RFC preserves repository-local terminal authority.

steps.task: Write five independently testable implementation packets with explicit dependencies and risk boundaries.
requirements: AdOps and dNh packets mutate Dopemux only; source repositories stay read-only.
GitHub and conversation connectors remain separate L3 boundaries.
Commit allowlists are pairwise disjoint; UI and service integration use frozen extension and router seams instead of reopening earlier packet files.
Every packet includes pytest -q tests/project_control_plane in both commit.verify and its final audit step.
The GitHub packet fixes the host to 127.0.0.1 in code and exposes no environment, configuration, or CLI widening path.
Every packet names exact interfaces, tests, verification, proof, and stop conditions.
validation: All packets validate against the canonical dopeTask schema.
Pairwise allowlist comparison finds no exact or ancestor-glob collision across the five implementation packets.
All five validation ladders contain the PCP Core regression suite.
No packet is represented as active, accepted, or dispatchable before its dependencies.

steps.task: Validate the complete design diff, freeze one content head, and prepare one independent Pro architecture audit.
requirements: Run every deterministic command in commit.verify.
Audit the exact frozen head once for PCP/RDCP reuse, authority leakage, dependency correctness, testability, and duplication.
Keep the PR draft and unmerged until audit disposition and Control Tower review.
validation: Deterministic validation results are recorded honestly.
The independent audit is bound to the exact final content head or readiness remains blocked.
No implementation or terminal action occurs.
